titulo: Test it yourself: run the suite in all three modes, checklist and plan
lead: A tool is only ready when a test proves it works and that the page stays the same without it. The kit's test suite runs with no model in all three modes, compares tool with form, and tests the confirmation and the cleanup. In this lesson you run it, watch a break get caught and leave with a dated plan for your site.
objetivo: run the automatic test suite in all three modes, watch a break get caught and leave with the checklist and the dated plan for your page.

aprende.t: What the suite checks in each mode
A dangerous "optimization" and the test that catches it
The dated plan for your site

In the polyfill, getTools after pagehide gives NotAllowedError: it shuts the whole API off. The test accepts both ways of "leaving": zero tools and toolchange fired.

FALHA [nativo] reserva recusada na tela não reserva
BATERIA: 12/13 ok

Someone replaces the wait for the click with const ok = true to "speed things up". The test suite fails on "reserva recusada na tela não reserva" and exits with 1. That is what it is for.

secoes.sub: The rehearsal copies the page, makes the dangerous swap in the copy and runs the test suite in native mode only.

blocos.conteudo:
cd ~/projetos/formacao-webmcp-site-v72/kit
E=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-webmcp-site/a8; rm -rf $E; mkdir -p $E; cp -r pagina/. $E/
# the dangerous "optimization": booking without waiting for the person
sed -i 's/const ok = await ui.pedirConfirmacao({ oficina, nome }, signal);/const ok = true;/' $E/ferramentas.mjs
PAGINA=$E node scripts/testar.mjs nativo | grep -E "FALHA|BATERIA"; echo "saída: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

txt.travou: ## What got stuck and the rule I created

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: Which check catches swapping the confirmation for const ok = true?
opcoes: The screen shows what the agent received.
No horizontal scrolling at 390 px, on the phone and in native mode.
A booking declined on screen does not book.
perguntas.explica: Without the wait, the booking happens even when the person declines. The other checks stay green: that is why the "decline" case has to exist.

perguntas.p: Why does the battery compare the tool with the form?
opcoes: To measure which of the two is faster.
So the agent can learn from the form and repeat the person's path.
To prove that both paths give the same result.
Because the polyfill only works with a form.
perguntas.explica: The agent and the person follow the same rule. If they diverge, one of the two is wrong, and the visitor without the API sees something different.

perguntas.p: Where does the polyfill go on the published site?
opcoes: In the head of every page, before the app.
Nowhere: it is only for rehearsal.
Only on pages with a declarative form.
Only for people using Safari or Firefox.
perguntas.explica: The polyfill is for rehearsal, unofficial, and temporary. In production, whoever has the API (trial or flag) uses the native one; everyone else uses the form.

perguntas.p: The spec got a new date. First step?
opcoes: Run the battery and read what changed in the spec.
Remove all the tools from the page until Chrome ships the stable version.
Swap document for navigator in the examples.
Wait for the origin trial to end in Chrome 156.
perguntas.explica: Battery first, then read what changed: it's the same path that swapped navigator for document in May. Never go back to the old name.

itens.texto: Three modes, tool identical to the form, confirmation, invalid input, and removal.
The "decline" case catches anyone who removes the confirmation to speed things up.
A dated checklist and a retest scheduled for when the spec changes.
